clips.title: The story
paras: At Auberdine, water from the moonwell carries purifying nature magic. The vial is used to test a mysterious red crystal set among Darkshore’s eastern ridges.

Water from Auberdine’s moonwell fills the tube. The sacred pool is tied to Elune and holds restorative, purifying magic. Even a small amount can be used against corruption or to test strange mystical forces.
